newsitem.title: USA: Municipal sales total $773 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal sales total $773 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $773 million in 38 offerings for Thursday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $244 million in 25 issues. The largest issue is a $36.7 million Las Vegas refunding at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $529 million in 13 offerings. The largest is a $166 million Illinois Health Facilities Authority issue through Smith Barney Inc.

An additional $113 million of negotiated deals are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price them Thursday depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
